doc: RetPushState describes the web push capabilities of the browser. It answers a [CallPushState] and a [CallPushSubscribe], which has not subscribed.

1.doc: Keep is kept to avoid falling back to the zero value which breaks polymorphism at protocol level.
1.name: Keep

2.doc: Supported is true, if the browser provides service workers, the push manager and notifications.
2.name: Supported

3.doc: Permission is the permission for notifications, one of default, granted or denied. It is empty, if web push is not supported.
3.name: Permission

4.doc: Endpoint is the endpoint of the push subscription of the browser for the service worker of nago. It is empty, if there is none.
4.name: Endpoint

5.doc: Standalone is true, if the application runs as an installed web app.
5.name: Standalone

6.doc: RequiresInstall is true, if the browser supports web push only for an installed web app, which this is not, like Safari on iOS and iPadOS.
6.name: RequiresInstall
